mintAuthority.summary: ZSD is minted and redeemed through Zephyr's native reserve-ratio protocol rules against ZEPH collateral. Source code review confirms no admin/emergency mint path: all transaction_type enum values (MINT_STABLE, MINT_RESERVE, MINT_YIELD) are user-facing; blockchain.cpp contains no admin override. The Zephyr foundation controls the oracle RSA signing key (cryptonote_config.h), a price-feed centralization vector, but not a privileged mint bypass.

controls.label: Zephyr native reserve mint/redeem rules
controls.capDescription: Minting depends on native reserve-ratio and oracle rules in protocol consensus; no EVM-style privileged minter exists.
controls.evidence: Source review of the still-current v2.3.0 release confirmed the transaction_type enum lists only user-facing types (MINT_STABLE, REDEEM_STABLE, MINT_RESERVE, REDEEM_RESERVE, MINT_YIELD, REDEEM_YIELD, TRANSFER variants, AUDIT types) — no ADMIN_MINT or emergency bypass type. blockchain.cpp contains no admin, foundation, emergency, or bypass mint surface. cryptonote_config.h includes a hardcoded foundation oracle RSA key (ORACLE_PUBLIC_KEY), which controls price-feed signing but is not a direct mint authority. The failure domain is anchored to Zephyr consensus itself: there is no privileged contract or account with mint authority, and mint/redeem remains open to users against ZEPH collateral under deterministic reserve-ratio rules at HF11 block 837231.

sources.label: Zephyr GitHub - native mint transaction types

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. GitHub still identifies v2.3.0 (commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a) as the latest official release, and Explorer block 837231 confirms the live network remains on HF11. The source exposes only reserve-ratio-gated user MINT_STABLE, MINT_RESERVE, and MINT_YIELD transaction types; no admin, emergency, or foundation mint bypass was found in enums.h, blockchain.cpp, or cryptonote_tx_utils.cpp. ZSD issuance is a native consensus conversion, not an issuer-backend reserve reconciliation path, so reconciliation is explicitly not-applicable. The foundation oracle RSA key is a price-feed centralization vector, not a direct mint authority. No named prudential supervisor is evidenced by the reviewed protocol materials.
